[Pending Restart] [Cryotherapist] Cryotherapy now rolls its healing like Ignite. (This means that if you hit with Frostbolt for 4000 damage, and 2000 of this was converted to healing, when you Frostbolt again and add 2000 to this healing, instead of overwriting it, they will add together towards the next heal.)

[Pending Restart] [Vampire Lord] Unholy light no longer deals damage, and instead does Shadow healing to targeted Allies. (This gives Vampire Lord an emergency spot heal mechanic in scenarios where there are no monsters nearby to be damaged.)

[Pending Restart] [Vampire Lord] Fixed an issue where in some cases Vampire Lords healing effect was not acting in a smart way. It will now correctly smart heal the 5 lowest allies within range.
[Pending Restart] [Vampire Lord] The Vampire Lord heal effect now heals up to 5 party/raid members down from 10.

[Pending Restart] [Vampire Lord] Damage over time effects that trigger the Vampire Lord heal are now on a seperate internal cooldown to direct damage effects. (this avoids scenarios where a corruption tick could eat your shadowbolt damage from triggering a vampire lord heal.)

[Pending Restart] [Vampire Lord] The damage to healing conversion for periodic shadow damage abilities has been reduced from 5% to 2% of the damage dealt.( This is done because damage over time effects gain far more benefit from the 4% healing power coefficient on the Vampire Lord heal compared to direct damage effects.)
[Pending Restart] [Vampire Lord] The triggered Vampire Lord heal now scales from 4% of your bonus healing power.
